newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: FCW to suspend shares Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: FCW to suspend shares Wednesday.

text.p: FCW Holdings Bhd will suspend trading of its shares on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) Wednesday morning pending an announcement "later this week," according to a source within the company.
The source said on Tuesday that the announcement would be regarding "an acquisition" by the cable manufacturer but would not elaborate on any further details.
Market talk on Tuesday morning suggested that FCW is looking to acquire a 20 pct stake in financial conglomerate Commerce Asset Holdings Bhd from media group New Straits Times Press Bhd.
New Straits Times' stock was suspended on Tuesday for a company announcement.
